blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models enable efficient geometry estimation from sparse images, but their pretrained nature can make them vulnerable to distribution shifts beyond their training data. Identifying these failure modes is important for understanding when such models can be reliably deployed in unconstrained imaging settings. We investigate viewpoint variation as a controlled distribution shift by varying the angular span of sparse image inputs while keeping the input budget fixed. Across multiple feed-forward reconstruction models, we observe substantial degradation as viewpoint span increases, with wide spans producing both incomplete surface coverage and geometry unsupported by the observed imagery. These results reveal that viewpoint variation can induce failure modes beyond conventional reconstruction incompleteness, highlighting the need to evaluate pretrained feed-forward models under distribution shifts that challenge their learned geometric priors.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 3D重建模型能够从稀少的图像中有效进行几何估计,但是其事先训练的特性会使其易受到超出训练数据范围的分布转变的影响. 当这些模型能够可靠地部署在不受限制的成像环境中时,确定这些故障模式对于了解这些模式十分重要。 我们调查了差异作为控制分布转变的观点,即通过在固定投入预算的同时,改变稀少图像投入的角距。 在整个多条向前进的重建模型中,我们观察到,随着视野的扩大,大量退化,其广度既产生不完整的表面覆盖,也产生没有观测到的图像支持的几何特征。 这些结果表明,观点的变异可能诱发超出常规重建不完全的故障模式,这突出表明,在分配变化中,需要评估事先经过训练的饲料推进模式,因为这些模式对所学几何前科提出了挑战。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reconstructing three-dimensional scenes from sparse images requires accurate local geometry and consistent alignment across views [ 7 , 11 ] . Recent feed-forward approaches, including VGGT [ 8 ] , Pi3X [ 13 , 12 ] , and VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 9 ] , efficiently estimate scene geometry and camera parameters from unposed images. For urban scene reconstruction, however, their reliability also depends on handling substantial viewpoint variation as cameras move around the target structure.
blocks.zh: 从稀少的图像中重建三维场景,需要准确的局部几何和一致的对视[7,11]. 最近的向导方法,包括VGGT [8],Pi3X [13,12],和VGGT-ship /Omega [9],高效地估计了场景几何和来自未配置图像的相机参数. 然而,对于城市景观重建来说,其可靠性也取决于在照相机绕着目标结构移动时处理显著的视差变化。

blocks.en: Orbital capture presents a trade-off between surface coverage and inter-view consistency. Wider coverage reveals additional facades, but, under a fixed image budget, also increases the spacing between observations. Changes in visibility, appearance, and occlusion can then reduce cross-view overlap and complicate correspondence [ 5 , 6 ] , potentially producing distorted geometry or spatially separated copies of the same building [ 14 ] . Such failures require evaluating not only surface coverage, but also whether the reconstructed geometry forms a coherent scene.
blocks.zh: 轨道捕捉呈现出表面覆盖度和视界一致性之间的权衡. 覆盖面扩大后会发现更多的外观,但根据固定的图像预算,也会增加观测之间的间隔。 可见度、外观和隐蔽性的变化可以减少交叉视图重叠,使通信 [5,6] 复杂化,有可能产生扭曲的几何或空间分离的同一建筑物副本[14]。 这种失败不仅需要评估表面覆盖,还需要评估重建后的几何是否形成一个连贯的场景.

blocks.en: We study this behavior by evaluating VGGT, Pi3X, and VGGT- Ω \Omega on two scenes using ten-image trajectories spanning 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} to 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} . Each complete prediction, including duplicated components, is aligned to a pseudo-reference with a single similarity transformation and evaluated using distance- and coverage-based metrics. VGGT and Pi3X degrade substantially as the span increases, while VGGT- Ω \Omega remains robust, preserving both surface completeness and global scene coherence, with markedly stronger agreement with the pseudo-reference. These results identify wide-span orbital capture as an important stress test for the global coherence of feed-forward reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们通过评价VGGT、Pi3X和VGGT-ship\Omega在两个场景上使用十进制轨迹来研究这一行为。 每个完整的预测,包括重复的组件,都与一个具有单一相似性转变的伪参照一致,并使用基于距离和覆盖范围的衡量标准进行评估。 VGGT和Pi3X随着跨度的增大而大幅递减,而VGGT-ship \Omega则保持坚固,既保持表面完整性,也保持全局场景的一致性,同时对伪引用有更强烈的一致. 这些结果表明,广宽轨道捕捉是全球饲料重建一致性的一个重要压力测试。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Traditional structure-from-motion and multi-view stereo pipelines combine feature matching, camera estimation, triangulation, and global optimization. Recent learning-based methods instead regress scene geometry directly from unposed images. DUSt3R [ 11 ] introduced pairwise point-map regression followed by global alignment, while MASt3R [ 5 ] augmented this representation with explicit dense matching. Fast3R [ 15 ] extended point-map prediction to many images in a single forward pass, and CUT3R [ 10 ] introduced a persistent state for online reconstruction. More recent unified models jointly estimate multiple geometric quantities: VGGT [ 8 ] predicts cameras, depth, point maps, and tracks; Pi3 [ 13 ] , subsequently extended as Pi3X [ 12 ] , adopts permutation-equivariant multi-view reasoning; and VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 9 ] improves cross-view reasoning through register-based information exchange and substantially expanded training.
blocks.zh: 传统结构的自动和多视立体管结合了特征匹配,相机估计,三角化,全球优化. 最近的基于学习的方法反而直接从未放置的图像倒退场景几何. DUST3R [11] 引入了双向点映射回归,然后是全局对齐,而MASt3R [5] 则以明显的密集匹配来增强这种代表. Fast3R [15] 将点映射预测扩展至单个前传中的许多图像,CUT3R [10] 引入了在线重建的持续状态. 较近的统一模型联合估计了多个几何量: VGGT [8] 预测相机,深度,点图,和轨迹; Pi3 [13] ,后扩展为 Pi3X [12] , 采用 permutation-equity-viewant 多视图推理; VGGT -\Omega [9] 通过基于注册的信息交换和大幅扩展的培训,改进了交叉视图推理.

blocks.en: Recent work has also examined reconstruction under challenging viewpoint changes. Zhang et al. [ 16 ] study extreme-view geometry primarily through relative pose estimation between image pairs with little or no visual overlap. Related approaches such as Glob3R [ 3 ] address drift and inconsistency through explicit global optimization. In contrast, we evaluate the native feed-forward behavior of multi-view orbital reconstruction, characterizing how increasing angular coverage under a fixed image budget affects global scene coherence.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作还在挑战性的观点变化下审查了重建问题。 张等. [16]主要通过图像对之间相对的姿势估计来研究极视几何,视觉重叠很少或没有. Glob3R[3]等相关方法通过明确的全球优化来解决漂移和不一致问题。 与此相反,我们评价了多视轨道重建的原生向导行为,描述在固定图像预算下增加角覆盖如何影响全球场景的一致性。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 3 实验设计

blocks.en: 3.1 Data and Viewpoint Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据和视图点取样

blocks.en: We evaluate two urban scenes: Scene I, centered on a building in downtown Toronto, and Scene II, centered on the Transamerica Pyramid. The central building of Scene I is characterized by predominantly vertical façades, whereas the Transamerica Pyramid narrows towards its apex. This selection allows us to examine whether similar reconstruction failures occur in different urban scenes and building shapes, rather than restricting the evaluation to an isolated case.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个城市场景:以多伦多市中心的一栋建筑为中心的场景一和以跨美洲金字塔为中心的场景二. 场景一的中心建筑以垂直外观为主,而跨美洲金字塔则向顶部缩小. 这一选择使我们能够审查是否在不同的城市场景和建筑形状中发生类似的重建失败,而不是将评价局限于一个孤立的案例。

blocks.en: For each scene, Google Earth Studio [ 4 ] is used to generate orbital trajectories around the central building with angular spans of 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} , 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} , 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , 135 ∘ 135^{\circ} , 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} , and 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} . Ten images are sampled uniformly from each trajectory and reconstructed independently using VGGT, Pi3X, and VGGT- Ω \Omega . This produces 42 reconstruction cases in total.
blocks.zh: 每个场景,Google地球工作室[4]用于在中央建筑周围产生轨道轨迹,角跨度为30~30~30~circ},45~45~circ},60~60~circ},90~90~crc},135~135~crc},180~180~crc},360~360~circ}. 使用 VGGT 、 Pi3X 和 VGGT - 组合 \ Omega 来对10 个图像进行采样并独立重构 。 这总共产生了42个重建案例。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 量化结果

blocks.en: The quantitative results for all 42 reconstruction cases are presented in Tables 1 and 2 . Both Scenes exhibit a consistent wide-span pattern: Pi3X and VGGT degrade substantially as the angular span increases, whereas VGGT- Ω \Omega maintains considerably stronger agreement with the pseudo-reference.
blocks.zh: 所有42个重建案例的量化结果见表1和表2。 两种场景都呈现出一致的宽幅图案:Pi3X和VGGT随着角跨度的增大而大幅递减,而VGGT-ship =Omega则与伪引用保持了相当强的一致.

blocks.en: For Scene I, Pi3X performs best at 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} and 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , with F-scores of 85.59 % 85.59\% and 84.41 % 84.41\% , respectively. Its performance then declines rapidly, reaching an F-score of 13.54 % 13.54\% at 135 ∘ 135^{\circ} . VGGT degrades more gradually at intermediate spans, but its F-score falls to 9.99 % 9.99\% at 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} . At 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} , Pi3X and VGGT obtain F-scores of only 14.87 % 14.87\% and 23.69 % 23.69\% , respectively.

Its F-score varies within a comparatively narrow range of 81.03 % 81.03\% – 89.09 % 89.09\% , without the wide-span collapse observed for the other models. At 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} , it achieves its lowest normalized Chamfer distance ( 5.82 × 10 − 3 5.82\times 10^{-3} ) and EMD ( 50.20 × 10 − 3 50.20\times 10^{-3} ), together with an F-score of 86.05 % 86.05\% .

Scene II exhibits the same broad separation at wide spans. At 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} , Pi3X and VGGT obtain F-scores of 15.26 % 15.26\% and 9.44 % 9.44\% , whereas VGGT- Ω \Omega reaches 94.74 % 94.74\% . The corresponding normalized Chamfer distances are 1860.48 × 10 − 3 1860.48\times 10^{-3} , 759.92 × 10 − 3 759.92\times 10^{-3} , and 3.82 × 10 − 3 3.82\times 10^{-3} , respectively. VGGT- Ω \Omega therefore preserves strong reference agreement on both scenes, despite the different geometries of the central buildings and the different scene contexts.

blocks.en: 4.2 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 定性结果

blocks.en: Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 reveals that the wide-span degradation of VGGT and Pi3X is not limited to a gradual loss of surface detail. At large angular spans, the models fail to associate observations of the same physical building across widely separated viewpoints within a consistent global frame. Consequently, view-specific reconstructions are placed at incompatible positions or orientations, producing multiple displaced copies and severely distorted structures. The result is a visually catastrophic failure of scene assembly, even when individual facade fragments remain locally recognizable.
blocks.zh: 图1和图2揭示了VGGT和Pi3X的宽幅降解并不限于逐渐失去表面细节. 在大的角间距上,模型未能将同一有形建筑的观测数据与一个一致的全球框架内广泛分离的观点联系起来。 因此,针对特定观点的重建处于不相容的地位或方向,产生了多种流离失所的复制品和严重扭曲的结构。 结果是场景组装在视觉上灾难性的失败,即使个别表面碎片仍然可以在当地辨认。

blocks.en: In contrast, VGGT- Ω \Omega consistently consolidates the input views into a single building instance across the tested spans. Although its local surface detail may vary, it avoids the exaggerated duplication and fragmentation observed in VGGT and Pi3X. This qualitative difference agrees with the substantially lower distance errors and higher surface precision of VGGT- Ω \Omega in the wide-span settings.
blocks.zh: 对比之下, VGGT - ship – ship \ Omega 将输入视图在测试跨度内一致合并为单一的建筑实例 。 虽然它的局部表面细节可能有所不同,但它避免了在VGGT和Pi3X中观察到的夸张的重复和破碎. 这种质量差异与VGGT-ship\Omega在宽幅设置中的距离误差大为降低和表面精度较高是一致的。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Global Coherence under Wide Viewpoint Spans
blocks.zh: 5.1 广视点下的全球一致性

blocks.en: Our results suggest that wide-span orbital reconstruction challenges global scene coherence, rather than merely surface completeness. With ten input images, wider trajectories increase surface coverage but also increase inter-view spacing, potentially weakening correspondence through occlusion and appearance changes. VGGT and Pi3X produce displaced building components at large spans, whereas VGGT- Ω \Omega maintains substantially stronger pseudo-reference agreement. Because each complete prediction receives only one similarity transformation, incompatible components cannot be independently realigned to conceal these failures. The observed degradation is therefore consistent with errors in relative scene assembly, rather than only an arbitrary global coordinate frame or scale.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,宽宽的轨道重建对全球场景的一致性提出了挑战,而不仅仅是表面完整性。 有了10个输入图像,更宽的轨迹会增加表面覆盖度,同时也会增加视距,有可能通过隐蔽和外观变化削弱通信. VGGT和Pi3X在很大范围内产生取代的建筑组件,而VGGT-ship \Omega则维持相当强大的伪参照协议. 由于每个完整的预测只得到一个相似性转换,不兼容的组件无法独立调整以掩盖这些失败. 因此,观察到的退化与相对场景组装中的错误是一致的,而不仅仅是任意的全球坐标框架或尺度.

blocks.en: 5.2 Geometric Supervision and Training Exposure
blocks.zh: 5.2 几何监督和培训接触

blocks.en: VGGT’s separate camera, depth, and world-point heads do not architecturally enforce consistency between their predictions [ 8 ] . Pi3X transforms local point maps using predicted cameras, so pose errors can displace otherwise plausible surfaces; its public training implementation leaves the cross-view unprojection loss disabled [ 12 ] . In contrast, VGGT- Ω \Omega couples predicted depth and cameras through an unprojection-based point loss, explicitly supervises token-level matching, and exchanges cross-view information through scene registers [ 9 ] . These mechanisms plausibly support coherent scene assembly, although our experiments do not isolate their individual effects.
blocks.zh: VGGT的单独相机,深度,和世界点头在结构上不能强制其预测的一致性[8]. Pi3X 使用预测的相机转换局部点地图,因此产生错误可以取代本来可以想象的表面;它的公开训练执行使得交叉视图未预测损失被禁 [12]. 反之,VGGT - complete \Omega夫妇通过基于不预测的点损失来预测深度和相机,明确监督符号级别匹配,并通过场景记录交换交叉视图信息[9]. 这些机制可以合理地支持连贯的场景组装,尽管我们的实验并不孤立其单个效应.

blocks.en: Training exposure may reinforce these advantages. VGGT- Ω \Omega reports substantially expanded annotated data and self-supervised video training; its temporal-window sampling admits weakly overlapping observations [ 9 ] . This may improve robustness to sparse orbital inputs. However, outdoor imagery already appears in VGGT’s and the original Pi3’s training data, while Pi3X’s complete training mixture remains undisclosed [ 8 , 12 ] . Data diversity alone therefore cannot establish the cause of the observed performance gap.
blocks.zh: 培训风险可能强化这些优势。 VGGT - 组合\Omega报告大幅扩展附加说明的数据和自我监督的视频培训;其时间窗口抽样承认弱重叠的观测[9]. 这可能提高轨道投入的强度。 然而,户外图像已经出现在VGGT和最初的Pi3的训练数据中,而Pi3X’s完整的训练混合物仍未被披露[8,12]. 因此,仅靠数据多样性无法确定所观察到的业绩差距的原因。

blocks.en: 5.3 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 5.3 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: Our study covers two Google Earth Studio scenes under a fixed input, which makes the conclusions specific and reproducible while leaving several questions open for future work. Because angular span jointly controls viewpoint spacing and visible content, it defines a useful operating axis but not a decomposition of rotation from overlap; controlled experiments that vary overlap at fixed rotation would isolate the two effects and locate scene-dependent thresholds. The pseudo-references from VGGT- Ω \Omega likewise measure agreement with a strong reference model rather than independent geometric accuracy, so evaluation against independent references and direct pose metrics is a natural next step, together with training ablations that test the proposed explanations. To address these failures, future research can use viewpoint adaptation in 3D foundation models, where the model explicitly adapts its predictions to the available viewpoint distribution and overlap. This could be combined with gradient-free iterative refinement to progressively improve geometry under challenging viewing conditions without requiring model retraining.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究涵盖Google Earth Studio的两个场景,在一个固定的输入下,它使结论具体化,可以复制,同时留下几个问题供未来工作使用. 由于角横跨联合控制视距和可见内容,它定义了一个有用的操作轴,而不是从重叠中分解旋转;在固定旋转时不同重叠的受控实验将隔离两种效果并定位场景依赖阈值. VGGT- complete \ Omega同样使用强参考模型而不是独立的几何精确度来测量协议,因此,对照独立参考和直接设置衡量标准进行评价是自然的下一步,同时进行测试拟议解释的培训。 为了解决这些失败,未来的研究可以在3D基础模型中使用视角适应,在3D基础模型中,模式明确调整其预测以适应现有视角分布和重叠. 这可与无梯度迭代改进结合起来,在不要求模式再培训的情况下,在富有挑战性的取景条件下逐步改进几何。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Pretrained feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can encounter distribution shifts beyond their training data, making systematic identification of their failure modes important for assessing their reliability. We studied viewpoint-dependent failure under controlled changes in orbital coverage and found substantial wide-span degradation in Pi3X and VGGT, including globally inconsistent and unsupported geometry, while VGGT- Ω \Omega showed greater robustness. These results demonstrate that large viewpoint variation can expose failure modes beyond incomplete surface coverage, highlighting viewpoint shift as an important factor when evaluating pretrained feed-forward reconstruction models. More broadly, the study motivates systematic evaluation across distribution shifts to better characterize the reliability and limitations of feed-forward 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 事先经过培训的向导3D重建模型可能会遇到超出其培训数据范围的分布变化,因此系统识别其故障模式对评估其可靠性十分重要。 我们研究了在轨道覆盖的可控变化下依赖对角的故障,发现Pi3X和VGGT的大幅大面积降解,包括全球不一致和无支撑的几何结构,而VGGT-\Omega显示的强度更大。 这些结果表明,大的视距变化可能暴露出不完全覆盖的故障模式,在评价事先经过训练的向导重建模式时,突出视距变化是一个重要因素。 更广泛地说,该研究促使在分配的转变中进行系统评价,以便更好地说明向导3D重建的可靠性和局限性。
